name: Fruitimo! Juicy Night Ride
description:
About This Game

Ride a drone taxi through the night of Kajune Land!

『Fruitimo! Juicy Night Ride』 is a score-attack action game set in the nighttime world of Kajune Land.

Fruit-loving boy Vimita and his android grandpa ride a drone taxi through each course, vacuuming fruits, throwing jelly, and jumping through rings to earn points.

With simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoyable for both kids and adults.
The beautifully lit Kajune Land feels like a magical nighttime theme park.
Each stage takes about 5 minutes—replay again and again to achieve the perfect score!

▶ Game Features

Ride-Style Action on a Drone Taxi

The drone taxi automatically travels along the course, so there’s no need to control movement.

Focus on vacuuming fruits, throwing jelly, and jumping through rings to score points.

Explore Kajune Land at Night

Adventure through a glowing nighttime theme park.

  • 3 night stages

  • 3 sunset stages

Aim for the High Score

Fruits aren’t the only way to score.

Hitting various objects along the course with jelly can grant unexpected bonus points.

Try hitting everything you see around the theme park!

As you play, you’ll discover new scoring opportunities and learn the course layout, allowing you to aim for even higher scores.

Replay again and again, master the course, and achieve the ultimate perfect score!

The Fruitimo! Series

The Fruitimo! series is designed with the concept of a child’s first 3D game.

With simple controls and an approachable design, it’s a game that both kids and adults can enjoy together.

In Fruitimo! Juicy Night Ride, the score-attack gameplay expands even further in the nighttime theme park setting of Kajune Land.

The original Fruitimo! is also available on Steam!
